title: Palat Aa Meri Taraf
body:
Allah ne hussain se maqtal me ye kaha. palat aa meri taraf.
Tu mujh se raazi ho mai raazi ho gaya. Palat aa meri taraf.
<<DIVIDER>>
.1
Wadah jo maine Alame arwah main liyaa.
Tu ne har ek wada wafa kar dikha diya.
Tera har ek qadam mere liye utha.
Palat aa meri taraf palat aa meri taraf.
.2
Maine har ek nabi ko sunai thi karbala.
Lekin tere siwa koi razi nhi huaa.
Han bha gai mujhe teri har ek ada.
Palat aa meri taraf palat aa meri taraf
.3
Tune jawan bete ka lasha utha liya
phir shukr uski laash pa mera ada kiya
Ansar kar diye mujh par sabhi Fida.
Palat aa meri taraf palat aa meri taraf.
.4
Abbas jaise bhai ke bazu hue qalam.
Hain itne zakhm teri kamar ho gai hai khum
Besheer ka lahu chehre pe hai mala
Palat aa meri taraf palat aa meri taraf.
.5
Be chain tere ghum me hui Aaj syeda
Bikhraye baal dasht me padhti hain marsiya.
Ankho me ashk hain honto pe hai sada
<<DIVIDER>>
____Haaan_____
<<DIVIDER>>
Allah ki sada ko suna jab hussain ne.
Ek baar sue Asma dekha hussain ne.
<<DIVIDER>>
Phir kaam ye kiya.. mola hussain ne.
Talwar ko rakha..mola hussain ne.
Sar ko jhuka liyaa.. mola hussain ne.
Shukre khuda kiya.. mola hussain ne.
Phir rab ne Shah se ek baar ye kaha.
.6
Me aa raha hu teri taraf aye mere khuda.
Mere liye ye kaafi hai tu raazi ho gaya.
tu mujh se razi ho phir mujh se ye kaha
Palat aa meri taraf palat aa meri taraf.
.7
Johar Ali jhukaya jo sajde me sheh ne sar
Khanjar udhr chalane Iaga shimre bad shiyar.
Khanjar idhar chala aayi udhar nida
Palat aa meri taraf palat aa meri taraf..
<<DIVIDER>>
